lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; triage 1,898/1,933 agree, no value difference; differences are candidate-unknown (the reply reads sales.route, which is asked only when sd.route_each is Yes) and candidate-refuses (6 on completed returns: the reply's own consistency refusal of an aggregate route that fails Exception 1, which the project refuses at sales.one through sales.bad_aggregate). i1040sd p. 10, lines 1a and 8a: "You can report on line 1a ... or line 8a ... the aggregate totals from any transactions ... for which" basis was reported and no adjustment shown, and "If you choose to report these transactions on lines 1a and 8a, don't report them on Form 8949": aggregation is the filer's option, and with sd.route_each No every sale is listed on Form 8949 (sales.detail), which the project's choose returns. The reply's note that choose cannot yield an enum value is mistaken (the project's line is such a choose); it ignores the parent question.

Ruling: scope; same reply and project as the round-2 and round-3 rulings. f8949 p. 1, box G; i8949 p. 8, code B. The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes, but boxes G to L are refused at the transaction by sales.digital at sales.one. Triage executable-triage-v2 (reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json; 1,638 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 476 partial records): 1,758 of 1,765 comparisons agree; the 7 value differences are all on refused returns (boxes G and J); no completed return differs. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i8949 p. 8, code B, 'Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)', and p. 10, code W, 'enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)'. Values on the supported case are the project's (reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW); boxes G and J are refused with every digital-asset box (sales.digital) and codes other than B and W at sales.bad_code (scope). The reply's own consistency gate (sales.h_wash_excess) figures the loss from sales.correct_basis, which is $0 when the code is W alone, and so refuses completed returns the project computes: sales.adjust.A.W, sales.adjust.D.W, sales.adjust.A.W.equal_loss (project column (g) $500.00, $500.00, $200.00; e.g. A.W: proceeds $6,000, reported basis $7,000, wash loss $500). The project refuses only a wash-sale loss above the loss after any code B correction (sales.wash_bad). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/sales.json`, pass b91cbaa4b1d2): 1,616 of 1,951 agree, no value differs; 316 candidate-unknown (the reply reads sales.route, asked only after sd.route_each), 6 candidate-refuses (the three above, and special or other-code sales refused by the project at sales.one), 13 project-unknown. Same reading as the earlier rounds. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and model error; i8949 p. 11, column (h). The value is the project's ((d) less (e) plus (g)); the reply shows the line only on the detail route, but the transaction's column (h) amount is read on both routes (sd.line1a.h and sd.line8a.h for the aggregate route), and the project's sheet is a values sheet, so the display condition changes no value. Its candidate refusals are column (g)'s h_wash_excess gate (see (g)).
